name: 共有元の人物を添えた資料行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lighthouse Japanese catalog LH15-0003 only, shared-file row with sender.
Redesign ONE compact row, no page or device, white background.
Reference hierarchy: image 1 ORIGINAL source is primary for icon geometry, optical weight, alignment, spacing, fine controls and original artwork. Use ONLY its shared recipe document row at x39 y557 w1104 h189. Preserve its small circular portrait and overlapping white circular document-artwork badge, original blue document glyph with white lines, gray two-person shared glyph before sender metadata, horizontal three-dot overflow. Do not invent a different portrait. Image 2 OUR MOCK is secondary for Japanese copy/layout and typography; its mint initial avatar, blank green page vector and absent shared-people glyph are rough substitutions to correct. Image 3 approved bus is only white-surface, subtle outline and soft elevation style, no borrowed content.
Exact visible Japanese copy: title "日曜日の配布資料"; second line "佐藤さんから共有 · 火曜日". No other copy. Portrait replaces mock's decorative initial "佐"; do not add that letter over the photo. Preserve Japanese content and middle dot spacing.
Logical typography Meiryo Regular 14/24px title, Regular12/16px metadata, tracking0. No new bold heading. Uniform higher-resolution scaling allowed.
Composition logical width390px, compact approximately64px high: portrait plus overlapping document type badge on left, text block beside it, overflow far right. The tiny shared-people glyph precedes metadata like original; retain adequate width for full Japanese line without clipping. One quiet white rounded surface, fine neutral border, soft downward shadow on white canvas, modest margins.
Palette: #1D1D1D text, #6E6E6E metadata, #526173 supporting/shared glyph and overflow. Keep original portrait colors and original blue document artwork. No mint member chip or random colored icon backgrounds. Blue is retained solely as original file-type artwork; no blue action or selection. No primary CTA exists, so no invented brand button/gradient.
Keep original fine icon shapes and proportions; never copy the mock's malformed substitutes. No invented extra controls, rows, badges, names, dates, headings, metrics, English, watermark or annotations. Render full component and exact content. This is a static design candidate.
reviewNotes: 生成を実際に目視。日本語2行、共有の人物アイコン、青い元資料形式、三点操作を保持。原図優先により自作の緑の白紙や無地の丸は使わず。しかし人物写真の厳密な保持は不十分で、再解釈された顔と拡大された円に見える。写真と小さな重なりの比例を原図へ戻す対象修正が必要。厳密なMeiryoメトリクス未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
